steps.text: Tick, tock...
Brush, draw...
Tick, tock...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Hello! You've got a package!

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Please leave it at the door, thank you.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: No problem!

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: And now I've forgotten what I was going to draw...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Never mind. I'll think about it later.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: I should see what's in this package.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: A painting?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: But I make paintings, not buy them. Who is it from?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Strange. There's no sender or recipient.
Deepcolor knows, however, that it is meant for her.
Everything about it is familiar, from the colors to the texture.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Thank you, whoever sent it.
She leaves it by the easel, and resumes her painting.
She eventually finishes her latest work, but it is not the image she had envisioned. It is a reproduction of the 'painting.'
She finds her attention constantly drawn to that curious sense of familiarity, her eyes wandering from the canvas, her mind recreating the colors in its frame...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Maybe it's time for a break.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: So many visitors today...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: And what do you want?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: To watch you draw. Any new paintings today?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: But there's something on the canvas.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: A stream, a forest, a wooden hut?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: It's a reproduction. Someone sent me a painting, and it was all I could think of, so I just copied it.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Copying is painting too.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: The ideas and techniques aren't mine. It's just practice; the painting doesn't belong to me.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: That doesn't make a difference to me. I like it, as long as it's information that you painted with your own hand using your own brush and paint.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Anyway, I'm not painting today. Go.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: What is it? You're entranced by the painting too?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: It feels... familiar.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Don't you think so?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Yes, that sense of familiarity is what's preventing me from moving my brush. You can take it if you want.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: But you've already seen it. Would me taking it change anything?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: I suppose not...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: What do we do, then?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Investigate? Explore?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: No choice, I suppose... as you say.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Let's go!

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Hey, are you not going to prepare at all? At least bring the painting?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: You want to know where that package is from?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Yes. There's no sender or recipient, but it was clearly meant for me, so I wanted to know where it came from.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: It couldn't have just—

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: I'm sorry, but I don't remember handling this one at all.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: It wasn't there when I went through the checkpoint when I came in. Are you sure I delivered it?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Don't worry though, I'll look it up. Might be some kind of anti-scam exercise from HR.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Give me a moment.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Where did you go?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: The Messenger who delivered it says he doesn't remember...

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: I asked my friends. They know where it came from.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Where?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Follow the river and keep going. You'll see it.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: A stream, a forest, a wooden hut.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: You must be joking. How many streams are there in Terra?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: My friends gave me the location. I'll lead the way.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Alright, wait here...

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Fetching my brush and canvas.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Wait! One moment.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Let me catch my breath...

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: How long have we been walking?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Days? Weeks?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Are you tired? Do you need me to carry your tools for you?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: No, I'm a painter. I can carry my own gear...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Are you thinking about picking up painting?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: I'd love to, but I couldn't learn it even if I tried.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Then help me get my paints ready. If we're taking a break, I want to use that time to paint something.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Still no good...
Even facing completely different scenery, Deepcolor still ends up drawing the scene from the painting.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: What's wrong with the one you're painting now?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: I haven't drawn the hut yet, but... it's strange.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Why is it exactly the same, even when I'm using different paints?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Are you still copying?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Is it really copying if you're drawing natural scenery like it's real?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: That's called imitation.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Is that different?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Then shouldn't you be calling it imitation, rather than copying?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Stop confusing the concepts...

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Look in front of you.
On the other side of the canvas, Deepcolor finds herself looking at the scenery she had just depicted.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: What's going on? I thought it was a meadow in front of us. Where did the stream come from?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: You draw well. It's exactly like nature.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Do we follow this stream to our destination?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Perhaps...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: This is getting stranger by the moment...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Can you help me put away the easel, assistant?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: What are you doubting, Deepcolor?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: This feels... familiar...

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: That painting again?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: It's this place. The forest and the stream.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: This is the place the painting depicts...

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: I see the wooden hut. The one in the painting.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: We're here...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Is this the place?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: It looks the same from where I am.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Let's go in, then.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: I'll wait for you at the door.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: You're not coming?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: I can't. I don't see the door.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Here's the door. Look, I opened it.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: I'm sorry, I still don't see anything.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: You go. I'll wait here.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Wait for me, then. I'll be back soon.
No one has lived here for a long time. The furniture is battered and broken, paintings are scattered everywhere, and there is a thick layer of dust on everything.
She feels an intense familiarity. Not in an eerie sense like that painting, but one full of intimacy and yearning.
It's like...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Home?
Deepcolor picks up a painting and brushes away the dust, revealing the tattered truth.
When painting becomes life, life becomes poison.
There is no choice but to follow it downstream.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Trees, stream, hut... why are all the paintings the same?
Deepcolor takes a painting off the wall and blows away the past's shackles.
There is a paradise for painters in a faraway land...
Follow the stream, and you'll reach it.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: *Cough* Isn't this an oval frame used for portraits? Why is it still the same?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Could the sketchbook be...
Deepcolor opens the sketchbook on the table. The pages flutter, revealing an aged warning.
The hand that cannot draw beauty, the heart that has never seen beauty. Heaven is out of reach, but self-destruction is near.
Follow the stream...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Every page is just the scenery outside.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Did the owner of this house go mad?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Well, she drew so many, so I might as well leave her this one.
The painting makes a dull sound as it hit the ground.
It will be forgotten here, to be buried in the dust.
Until...
Her last painting becomes eternity.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: You're back. Did you find anything?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: No.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: What about the painting?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: I left it inside. Didn't want to remember it anymore.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Can you paint now?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Here?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Won't I just end up drawing the same scenery again?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Only one way to find out.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: I guess you're right. I'll try.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: There.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Isn't it the same painting?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: No. Look, the lighting and angle here, and the application of colors, all different.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Something's missing...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: It's not a matter of technique... strange...

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: ...You said your friends told you the painting came from here.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Yes. Is there a problem?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Can your friends go inside the house?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: No, they can't.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Then, how did they know where the painting came from?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: 'Follow the stream. It lies at the very end.'

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: That's what they said.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: What lies at the end of the stream?

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: What the owner of the house wanted.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Put this painting away for me, assistant.

steps.name: 'Supporter Operator'
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Then, we can follow the stream.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: What lies at the end of the stream?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Do you still have water, assistant?

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: Only the seawater before us.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: I'm hungry... tired... nobody would come here to paint...

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: Paint? Of course not.

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: They come to survive.

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: Look.
The assistant points towards a pile of scattered painting tools.
The paint is all dried up, and broken easel pieces litter the floor.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Poor thing...

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: There is no place for her anywhere else.

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: Survival permits no impurity.

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: One must abandon everything else in order to survive.
Deepcolor sees a familiar picture frame amidst the reefs.
Broken, dying.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: That's the painting from the package...

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: She wanted to give it to me...

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: And I left it behind in the house?

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: Yes. You don't need it anymore.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Perhaps I should... leave a souvenir?

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: We could send back the reproduction you made.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Let's do that.

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: What about us?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: We keep going.

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: This is the end. Where are you going?
Deepcolor steps into the ocean.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: The ocean took her, didn't it?

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: One who has touched seawater can never go back.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Did she have a choice?

steps.name: 'Deacon'
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Then neither do I. Am I wrong?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Let's go, assistant. What was started must be finished.
It is not water that fills the oceans.
It is ink, paint, colors.
It seeps into every one of Deepcolor's nerve strands, wiping away all her emotions.
She becomes pure, perfect.
Many voices sing along with her, extolling the harmony of survival.
She ascends and tries to sing in harmony.
But she does not sing. She raises her brush.
The singing comes to an abrupt stop.

steps.name: 'Assistant'
steps.text: This is not how survival is expressed, Deepcolor.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: I live. I must paint.

steps.name: 'Assistant'
steps.text: Painting does not protect. Painting does not nourish. It is illogical for survival.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Yes, but to paint is to live. How could I stop?
The brush dips into the ink of the ocean, and colors fly through the water.

steps.name: 'Assistant'
steps.text: Have you forgotten why you embraced the ocean?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Of course I haven't. Giving up painting for survival, and meeting the end in bitter hatred.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: That's why she drowned. I'm alive. I must express.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: I won't abandon color, canvas, or brush. I'm not stopping anymore.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Draw with me, assistant.

steps.name: 'Assistant'
steps.text: We must stockpile energy, overcome weakness, seek evolution.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Yes. We can paint even better.

steps.name: 'Assistant'
steps.text: In evolution, this is a fallacy.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: So what?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: I'm not heeding the call of the many. Whatever of me is left, I give to painting.
Stroke by stroke, she fills the sea with color.
Even the ocean could not stop her expression.
Seawater mixes with paint, separates, then mixes again, gradually leaving their mark on the ocean.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Come, assistant, this is a lot to do on my own.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Gather the colors to me. Don't let them disperse.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: What did you say? Our brethren are gone?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: It's their many. What has it to do with us, with me?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Is the palette ready? The ocean is waiting for us to color it!

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Are you there, assistant?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Assistant?

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Phew. I guess I'll stop there.
Blocks of blue form the subject of the painting on her canvas.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: This is our story. But was the last part a little too intense?
The tentacles extending from the palette sway side to side, perhaps a sign of affirmation, or of denial.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: The life of a Seaborn is so repressed, after all. Can't fault one for being a little radical in protesting it.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: That's it for this painting. Let's cover it up and put it through the process, or HR really will kick me off the ship once more operators complain.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: It was hard enough finding somewhere I can paint in peace, without having to deal with those things. I'd rather not be forced on the run again.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Hello! You've got a package!

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Coming!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Operator Deepcolor? The stuff you ordered is here. Painting supplies and a picture frame.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Please check if everything is alright, then sign here.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Here?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Yeah... hm.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: I thought you'd write in blue too.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Ha.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Have a nice day!

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Deepcolor
steps.text: What should I paint next?
